subtitle.en: From response data and cross-species tests to receptor design and molecular access.
subtitle.zh: 從反應資料與跨物種檢驗，走向受體設計及分子進出機制。

intro.en: AeroSense needs receptors that help distinguish mold-associated volatile patterns. We combine response data and receptor sequences with molecular size, measured and computed vibrations, learned odor features, cross-species evaluation, structural models and molecular dynamics. The studies below connect each question to its method, result and next design decision.
intro.zh: AeroSense 需要能協助辨識霉菌相關揮發物模式的受體。我們結合反應資料與受體序列，測試分子尺寸、實測及計算振動、AI 氣味特徵，並進行跨物種評估、結構建模與分子動力學研究。以下將各項研究的目的、方法、結果與下一個設計決策串起來。

takeaway.en: Sequence features improved within-species response prediction. Direct fly-to-mosquito transfer failed, and local sequence matching produced only a weak, unconfirmed signal. Mutation audits and membrane MD clarified the limits of docking and candidate access routes; improved selectivity and complete odorant entry or exit remain unverified.
takeaway.zh: 序列特徵改善物種內反應預測；果蠅至蚊子的直接轉移尚未成功，局部序列配對則有待確認的弱訊號。突變驗證與膜 MD 釐清了 docking 及候選路徑的限制，專一性改善與氣味分子的完整進出仍待驗證。

text.en: Published odor-response measurements guide Or22a / Or35a mutation screening. AlphaFold models and ColabFold predictions support structural hypotheses.
text.zh: 以公開氣味反應資料引導 Or22a／Or35a 突變篩選，並使用 AlphaFold 模型與 ColabFold 預測建立結構假說。

title.zh: 檢驗轉移｜Anopheles 蚊子受體

text.en: Compare fly-trained predictions with mosquito measurements, and test whether local sequence fragments identify receptors with similar response profiles. This is a separate test of generalization.
text.zh: 比較果蠅模型預測與蚊子實測，並檢驗局部序列片段能否找出反應輪廓相近的受體；這是另一條泛化驗證主線。

title.zh: 研究進出機制｜OR10 參考複合體

text.en: Cryo-EM structures 8V00 and 8V02 provide an unbound and o-cresol-bound reference: mosquito OR10 with three Orco subunits from Apocrypta bakeri. This separate model system does not validate Drosophila mutations.
text.zh: 冷凍電顯結構 8V00 與 8V02 分別提供未結合與結合 o-cresol 的參考：蚊子 OR10 與三個來自 Apocrypta bakeri 的 Orco。這是另一個機制研究系統，不能直接驗證果蠅突變。

title.en: Turn odor-response data into design candidates
title.zh: 把氣味反應資料轉為受體設計候選

question.en: Which receptors and sequence changes are worth testing for a selected mold-related odor panel?
question.zh: 對選定的霉味相關氣味組合，哪些受體與序列改變值得測試？

evidence.en: Adding receptor sequence features improved prediction for held-out receptors. Or22a and Or35a showed useful target-versus-control response differences in the published data.
evidence.zh: 加入受體序列特徵，改善了未見受體的反應預測。公開資料中的 Or22a 與 Or35a，對目標組與對照組呈現值得進一步探索的反應差異。

learning.en: Sequence is informative, but additional structural features did not establish a reliable prediction gain beyond it.
learning.zh: 序列提供有用資訊，但額外加入結構特徵，尚未證明能穩健提升預測。

change.en: Use predicted pockets to generate mutation hypotheses, then challenge their docking and contact explanations.
change.zh: 先以預測口袋提出突變假說，再檢驗 docking 分數與接觸解釋是否可靠。

design.en: Curate a benchmark of 24 Drosophila receptors and 110 odorants from published measurements. Compare a project-defined panel of mold-related volatiles with control odorants; these compounds are not assumed to be unique markers of mold. [1]
design.zh: 整理公開研究中的 24 個果蠅受體與 110 種氣味反應。比較專案定義的霉味相關揮發物與對照氣味；這些化合物不被視為霉菌獨有的標記。[1]

build.en: Combine molecular descriptors, receptor sequences and AlphaFold-derived structural features in matched prediction models. Generate Or22a / Or35a point-mutation models with ColabFold and dock target and control odorants. The build consists of computational sequences and structures. [4, 5]
build.zh: 在一致的評估架構中，結合分子描述、受體序列及 AlphaFold 結構特徵。以 ColabFold 建立 Or22a／Or35a 單點突變模型，並對接目標與對照氣味。此階段建構的是計算序列與結構。[4, 5]

test.en: For receptors excluded from training, R² increased from 0.1125 with ligand features to 0.2325 with sequence features. The full representation reached 0.2356; its additional gain had an uncertainty interval spanning zero. An initial docking screen suggested small relative preference shifts for F34Y and E196Q.
test.zh: 在訓練時未見的受體上，只有配體特徵的 R² 為 0.1125，加入序列後為 0.2325，全部特徵為 0.2356；最後這段增益的不確定度區間包含零。首輪 docking 中，F34Y 與 E196Q 呈現小幅相對偏好變化。

learn.en: A useful predictor can help prioritize experiments, but a small docking-score difference does not demonstrate improved selectivity. R² describes predictive fit, not percent accuracy.
learn.zh: 預測模型可協助安排候選優先順序，但小幅 docking 分數差不能證明專一性改善。R² 描述預測擬合程度，不是正確率百分比。

redesign.en: Move from ranking candidates to checking whether the proposed mutations actually contact the odorant and whether their ranking survives changes in docking setup.
redesign.zh: 下一輪從候選排名，轉向檢查突變位置是否接觸氣味分子，以及排名是否能承受 docking 設定的改變。

title.en: Test whether a better docking score supports selectivity
title.zh: 較好的 docking 分數，能否支持專一性？

question.en: Do the leading mutation hypotheses have a stable score advantage and a plausible structural explanation?
question.zh: 排名較前的突變，是否具有穩定的分數優勢與合理的結構解釋？

evidence.en: F34Y and E196Q lacked direct mutated-side-chain contacts in the inspected poses. Their relative preference changed with docking setup; no robust positive winner emerged.
evidence.zh: 在檢查的姿態中，F34Y 與 E196Q 的突變側鏈沒有直接接觸配體。相對偏好隨 docking 設定改變，未得到穩健的正向勝出者。

learning.en: A favorable score can reflect pose placement or search choices without supporting the proposed mutation mechanism.
learning.zh: 分數較佳可能來自姿態位置或搜尋設定，未必支持原先提出的突變機制。

change.en: Improve pocket and conformation assessment before expanding mutation claims; study access in an experimentally resolved reference complex.
change.zh: 先改善口袋與構型評估，再擴大突變推論；並以已有實驗結構的參考複合體，研究分子進出的問題。

design.en: Require both an interpretable ligand–residue relationship and a preference that is stable across reasonable docking choices.
design.zh: 要求候選同時具有可解釋的配體–殘基關係，以及在合理 docking 設定下仍穩定的相對偏好。

build.en: Align mutant and wild-type structures, compare a common search region with an alternative template-informed center, and inspect side-chain contacts. Define preference as the docking change for controls minus the change for mold-related odorants.
build.zh: 將突變與野生型結構對齊，比較共用搜尋範圍與模板引導的替代中心，並檢查側鏈接觸。相對偏好定義為對照組的 docking 變化，減去霉味相關組的變化。

test.en: Using a 4.5 Å contact criterion, neither F34Y nor E196Q supported a direct-contact explanation in the inspected poses. Candidate preference directions were sensitive to docking setup and odor-panel composition. No mutation maintained a robust positive preference across these checks.
test.zh: 以 4.5 Å 作為接觸判準，檢查的姿態未支持 F34Y 或 E196Q 的直接接觸解釋。候選偏好的方向對 docking 設定與氣味組合敏感；沒有突變在這些檢查下維持穩健的正向偏好。

learn.en: The first screen generated hypotheses, not validated engineered receptors. Lack of direct contact does not rule out indirect effects, but those effects were not demonstrated by these models.
learn.zh: 首輪篩選產生的是假說，尚非功能已驗證的工程受體。沒有直接接觸不排除間接效應，但目前模型也沒有證明這些效應。

redesign.en: Separate the functional-prediction question from the physical-access question. Use the OR10/Orco complex to test what docking alone leaves unresolved.
redesign.zh: 把功能反應預測與物理進出路徑分開檢驗，使用 OR10／Orco 複合體研究 docking 本身沒有回答的問題。

title.en: Ask whether receptor motion improves odor ranking
title.zh: 受體動態能否改善氣味反應排序？

question.en: Does an ensemble of receptor conformations explain odor responses better than a single static pocket?
question.zh: 一組動態受體構型，是否比單一靜態口袋更能解釋氣味反應？

evidence.en: MD supplied alternative pockets, but their docking–response correlations did not exceed the static apo reference in the expanded odor panel.
evidence.zh: MD 提供了不同口袋構型，但在擴充氣味組合中，對接與反應的相關性沒有優於靜態 apo 參考。

learning.en: More conformations do not automatically yield a better functional predictor. Docking also assumes the ligand has already reached the pocket.
learning.zh: 更多構型不一定產生更好的功能預測。Docking 同時預設了分子已經能到達口袋。

change.en: Investigate how the odorant reaches and leaves the pocket, alongside how it fits once placed there.
change.zh: 除了分子放入口袋後是否適合，也要研究它如何進入口袋與離開。

design.en: Use experimental unbound 8V00 and o-cresol-bound 8V02 structures as OR10/Orco references. Reconstructed unresolved loops are model assumptions, not experimentally observed coordinates. [2]
design.zh: 以實驗解析的未結合態 8V00 與 o-cresol 結合態 8V02 作為 OR10／Orco 參考。未解析迴圈的補建屬於模型假設，並非實驗觀察座標。[2]

build.en: Prepare the receptor complex in a hydrated POPC membrane with ions. Correct geometric and periodic-box problems before extending bound-state diagnostics to 20 ns and sampling unbound pockets with 5 ns MD. Cluster the pockets and dock odorants into representative conformations.
build.zh: 將受體複合體置於含水、離子的 POPC 脂膜。修正幾何與週期邊界問題後，將結合態診斷延伸至 20 ns，並以 5 ns 的 apo MD 取樣未結合口袋；再分群選出代表構型進行 docking。

test.en: In an expanded panel of 29 dockable odorants, Spearman correlations were 0.407 and 0.338 for two MD-derived model ensembles, compared with 0.450 for static 8V00 and 0.504 for static 8V02. Responses were digitized from a published calcium assay. An exploratory aromatic-ring-count baseline reached 0.790, highlighting chemical-panel effects. [3]
test.zh: 在擴充的 29 種可對接氣味中，兩個 MD 模型集合的 Spearman 相關係數分別為 0.407、0.338；靜態 8V00 為 0.450，靜態 8V02 為 0.504。反應值取自公開鈣訊號圖表的數位化。探索性的芳香環數量基準達 0.790，提醒我們注意氣味組合的化學分布影響。[3]

learn.en: These retrospective correlations do not establish sensitivity, EC50 or affinity. Different functional assays were kept separate, and short MD does not establish equilibrium or accuracy of the rebuilt regions.
learn.zh: 這些回溯性相關性不能直接推得敏感度、EC50 或親和力。不同功能 assay 分開分析，短時間 MD 也不代表已達平衡或補建區域必然正確。

redesign.en: Test molecular access explicitly, beginning with unbiased trajectories of o-cresol placed outside the apo receptor.
redesign.zh: 明確測試分子能否到達口袋，先將 o-cresol 放在 apo 受體外部，觀察無偏壓軌跡。

title.en: Reduce the distance between an odorant and its candidate entrance
title.zh: 縮短分子與候選入口的距離

question.en: Is failure to observe entry simply caused by waiting for the odorant to encounter the receptor?
question.zh: 沒有觀察到進入，是否只是分子尚未碰到受體？

evidence.en: Odorants contacted the membrane or receptor, but the analyzed trajectories did not meet the sustained pocket-entry criterion, including near-entrance simulations lasting 10 ns.
evidence.zh: 分子會接觸膜或受體，但分析的軌跡未達持續進入口袋的判準；從入口附近開始、長達 10 ns 的模擬也沒有觀察到持續進入。

learning.en: Bringing a ligand closer or increasing its local availability did not resolve pocket entry within the sampled time.
learning.zh: 在目前取樣時間內，讓分子靠近或提高局部可接觸的分子數，仍未解決入口通行問題。

change.en: Start at the known bound position and explore candidate exits to identify where access is obstructed.
change.zh: 改從已知結合位置探索候選出口，以定位阻礙通行的位置。

design.en: Distinguish reaching the receptor surface from actually occupying its binding pocket.
design.zh: 區分分子到達受體表面，以及真正進入結合口袋這兩件事。

build.en: Place o-cresol in external water, at the water–membrane interface, and near the candidate S3/S6 entrance. Compare low- and high-occupancy solvent preparations to explore encounter frequency, then reduce the initial diffusion distance directly.
build.zh: 將 o-cresol 放在外部水相、水–膜界面，以及 S3／S6 候選入口附近。先以較低與較高分子數的水層配置探索接觸機會，再直接縮短起始擴散距離。

test.en: Track pocket distance, receptor contacts and sustained occupancy. The available trajectories showed surface and membrane encounters but no sustained entry. The concentration exploration is preliminary and does not establish a concentration–response relationship.
test.zh: 追蹤口袋距離、受體接觸與持續佔據情形。已分析軌跡呈現表面與膜接觸，但沒有持續進入。濃度探索仍屬初步觀察，未建立濃度–反應關係。

learn.en: A nearby starting position does not guarantee a passable entrance. A missing event over nanoseconds cannot prove that natural entry is impossible.
learn.zh: 起點靠近不保證入口可通行。奈秒尺度內未見事件，也不能證明自然進入不可能發生。

redesign.en: Use the experimentally observed bound pose to explore outward motion and test receptor-side opening motions separately.
redesign.zh: 由實驗觀察到的結合姿態探索向外移動，並另行測試受體側面入口的開啟運動。

title.en: Test whether opening the entrance and waiting permits release
title.zh: 入口變寬、等待更久，分子就能離開嗎？

question.en: Can outward steering or a more apo-like entrance geometry produce a complete exit?
question.zh: 向外牽引，或讓入口更接近 apo 幾何，能否產生完整出口事件？

evidence.en: Initial outward steering encountered resistance. Guiding S3/S6 distances and extending the observation to 70 ns changed entrance geometry but produced no sustained exit.
evidence.zh: 初期向外牽引受到阻礙。引導 S3／S6 距離並延長觀察至 70 ns 後，入口幾何有變化，但仍未見持續移出。

learning.en: An entrance-distance change is not equivalent to a continuous passage for a molecule of finite size.
learning.zh: 入口距離改變，不等同於形成能容納完整分子的連續通道。

change.en: Search the saved structures for full-ligand routes and identify local clashes along those routes.
change.zh: 在保存構型中搜尋完整分子的通行路線，並定位沿路的局部碰撞。

design.en: Separate direct ligand pulling from receptor-side bias, and compare guided entrance motion with an unsteered control under the same observation schedule.
design.zh: 分開檢驗直接拉配體與引導受體入口，並在相同觀察時程下，比較入口引導與無新增偏壓的對照。

build.en: Use steered molecular dynamics (SMD) for exploratory outward motion. In a separate test, bias S3/S6 reference distances toward apo values while leaving o-cresol free of direct pulling. Extend the receptor-guidance protocol to a total of 70 ns, with the final 1 ns after bias removal.
build.zh: 使用牽引式分子動力學（SMD）探索向外移動。另一組測試則讓 S3／S6 參考距離朝 apo 值調整，氣味分子本身不受直接牽引；將入口引導流程延長至總長 70 ns，最後 1 ns 撤除偏置。

test.en: Assess entrance distances and ligand departure separately. Neither the guided nor the unsteered 70 ns trajectories met the sustained-exit criterion. The initial outward SMD attempts did not yield an accepted exit route for reverse-entry testing.
test.zh: 分別評估入口距離與分子離開情形。入口引導及無新增偏壓的 70 ns 軌跡都未達持續移出判準；初期向外 SMD 也未得到可供反向進入驗證的合格出口路線。

learn.en: Longer observation improved the opportunity to sample rearrangements but did not reveal an exit. The biased simulations do not measure a natural residence time, and 70 ns is insufficient to rule out slower events or other pathways.
learn.zh: 延長觀察增加了取樣重排的機會，但尚未揭示出口。受偏壓影響的模擬不測量自然停留時間；70 ns 未見事件，也不足以排除更慢的過程或其他路徑。

redesign.en: Replace a single opening-distance proxy with explicit position-and-orientation searches for the whole odorant, including nearby lipids.
redesign.zh: 從單一入口距離指標，轉為明確搜尋完整氣味分子的位置與朝向，並把周圍脂質納入考量。

title.en: Move from empty space to a testable molecular pathway
title.zh: 從幾何空隙，走向可檢驗的分子路徑

question.en: Can a complete odorant translate and rotate through the candidate corridors as its surroundings change?
question.zh: 當周圍環境改變時，完整氣味分子能否沿候選走廊平移、旋轉並通過？

evidence.en: Two candidate directions emerged, but whole-ligand searches across 24 saved conformations found no collision-free complete route. Dynamic route-following and longer local waiting also produced no complete exit.
evidence.zh: 搜尋得到兩個候選方向，但在 24 個保存構型的完整分子搜尋中，仍未找到無碰撞的完整路徑。動態沿路牽引與延長局部等待，也未產生完整出口。

learning.en: Local side-chain and lipid arrangements matter. Coordinated motion is a plausible explanation to test, but ligand-induced opening has not been demonstrated.
learning.zh: 局部側鏈與脂質排列會影響碰撞。協同運動是值得測試的解釋，但尚未證明分子移動會誘導入口開啟。

change.en: Design controlled, small-step movement and relaxation tests that track the ligand and its environment together.
change.zh: 設計有對照的小步移動與鬆弛測試，同時追蹤分子及周圍環境。

design.en: Distinguish a point-sized probe, a full rigid molecule and a flexible molecular environment. A geometrical centerline alone cannot establish passage.
design.zh: 區分點狀探針、完整剛性分子，以及可動的分子環境。只有幾何中心線，尚不能證明可通行。

build.en: Identify a lateral S3/S6 corridor and a lower-membrane-coordinate corridor. Search the translation and rotation of all 16 o-cresol atoms with the receptor and lipids fixed. Test route-following SMD with mobile surroundings, extend local waiting from 0.5 to 2 ns, then repeat the rigid searches across 24 conformations from the 70 ns trajectories.
build.zh: 找出 S3／S6 側向與膜座標較低方向兩條候選走廊。固定受體與脂質，搜尋包含全部 16 個原子的 o-cresol 平移及旋轉；接著允許環境移動進行沿路 SMD，把局部等待從 0.5 延至 2 ns，再將剛性搜尋擴展到 70 ns 軌跡中的 24 個構型。

test.en: No tested static conformation provided a complete collision-free route. Flexible pulling sometimes showed transient catch-up to the target, but no sustained release. In the least-repulsive selected protein-plus-lipid route, L128, Q292 and S291 and nearby lipids remained collision sources. The repulsion score diagnoses clashes; it is not a free-energy barrier.
test.zh: 測試的靜態構型皆未提供完整無碰撞路徑。柔性外拉偶爾短暫跟上目標，但沒有持續解除受阻或移出。選定路徑中，蛋白加脂質排斥最低的個案仍有 L128、Q292、S291 與附近脂質碰撞。排斥分數用於碰撞診斷，不是自由能障。

learn.en: The searches cover two finite corridors, not every possible route. Saved conformations are related snapshots, not independent experiments. Separate favorable segments cannot be joined to claim an observed trajectory; earlier SMD already allowed receptor motion without finding an exit.
learn.zh: 目前只搜尋兩條有限走廊，未涵蓋所有走法。保存構型彼此相關，不是獨立實驗；也不能拼接不同構型中較寬的片段，宣稱得到觀察到的軌跡。先前 SMD 已允許受體運動，仍未找到出口。

redesign.en: Propose small, controlled outward steps followed by relaxation, paired with a no-pull control. Measure side-chain, lipid and water rearrangements before and after ligand motion to distinguish competing mechanisms. This next design has not yet been tested.
redesign.zh: 下一步提出小幅、受控的向外移動，接續局部鬆弛，並搭配不牽引對照。比較分子移動前後的側鏈、脂質與水重排，以區分不同機制。這項新設計尚未測試。

title.en: Next designs: improve prediction and test coordinated motion
title.zh: 下一輪設計：改善預測，檢驗協同運動

intro.en: The feature benchmarks retain the original predictor as the reference, while the pathway studies provide candidate corridors and localized clashes. The next steps address both prediction and molecular access.
intro.zh: 特徵比較支持保留原預測器作為基準；路徑研究則提供候選走廊與局部碰撞位置。下一步分別處理反應預測與分子進出的問題。

items.en: Compare fixed and task-adapted molecular features using training-fold-only fitting, then independent functional data. LORAX and added 3D size descriptors remain proposed experiments. [33]
items.zh: 以訓練折內擬合比較固定與任務微調的分子特徵，再以獨立功能資料驗證；LORAX 及新增三維尺寸描述仍屬待測實驗。[33]

items.en: Compare small-step ligand guidance with a matched no-pull control; track the same local structural measurements.
items.zh: 比較小步分子引導與相配的不牽引對照，追蹤相同的局部結構量。

items.en: Accept a route only after checking continuous molecular positions, clashes and behavior after force removal. Reverse-entry testing follows only if a usable exit route is established.
items.zh: 以連續分子位置、碰撞與撤力後行為檢查路徑；建立可用出口後，才進行反向進入驗證。

items.en: Evaluate receptor designs with matched functional dose–response experiments before claiming improved selectivity or sensitivity.
items.zh: 在一致條件下進行功能濃度–反應實驗，再評估受體設計是否改善專一性或敏感度。

note.en: Planned study · No result is claimed for this proposed cycle.
note.zh: 待測研究｜此處尚無新循環的實驗結果。

intro.en: We have identified receptor candidates, built a response-prediction model and established a molecular-mechanism analysis workflow. We have not yet demonstrated that an engineered receptor is more sensitive.
intro.zh: 我們已選出受體候選、建立反應預測模型，以及分子機制分析流程；目前尚未證實改造後的受體更敏感。

title.zh: 1｜選出優先做功能實驗的受體

text.en: Published measurements support prioritizing Or22a and Or35a, two fly odorant receptors: their mean responses were higher for our selected mold-related odorants than for the control panel. These are evidence-based candidates, but mold specificity remains unproven. [1]
text.zh: 公開實驗資料支持優先研究 Or22a、Or35a（兩種果蠅氣味受體）：它們對我們選定的霉味相關氣味組，平均反應高於對照組。這是有資料支持的候選選擇，但尚未證明霉菌專一性。[1]

title.zh: 2｜建立受體—氣味反應預測模型

text.en: We curated 2,640 responses across 24 receptors and 110 odorants, combining receptor sequences with molecular features. [1] In the latest matched 109-odorant comparison, the baseline achieved R² ≈ 0.39 for held-out chemical groups. It has predictive value with substantial remaining error; R² is not percentage accuracy.
text.zh: 整理 24 個受體、110 種氣味、2,640 組反應，結合受體序列與分子特徵。[1] 最新 109 種氣味的相配比較中，原模型對未見化學類群的 R² 約 0.39，已有預測能力，但仍有明顯誤差；R² 衡量相對平均值基準的預測表現，不是 39% 準確率。

title.en: 3 · Vibrational and AI features connected to the predictor
title.zh: 3｜把振動頻譜與 AI 分子特徵接入模型

text.en: We processed and tested 82 measured IR (infrared) spectra, published quantum vibration modes for 85 odorants, and OpenPOM features for 109 odorants. OpenPOM learns molecular representations from odor descriptions. [27, 29, 31, 32] The workflow works, but these additions have not consistently outperformed the original model.
text.zh: 完成 82 種實測 IR（紅外線）頻譜、85 種公開量子振動模式，以及 109 種 OpenPOM 特徵的處理與模型比較。OpenPOM 是從氣味描述學習分子表示的 AI。[27, 29, 31, 32] 這套流程已能運作，但加入這些資訊尚未穩定超過原模型。

title.en: 4 · Candidate access directions and local obstructions
title.zh: 4｜找出候選進出方向與局部阻礙

text.en: In the mosquito reference complex, we established molecular dynamics (MD, simulation of atomic motion) in a membrane environment, extended simulations to 70 ns (nanoseconds) and identified two candidate access directions. Whole-molecule path scans located protein and lipid clashes. This identifies positions to investigate, but no route has been validated by complete molecular passage.
text.zh: 在蚊子受體參考系統中，建立膜環境的分子動力學（MD，逐步模擬原子運動），將模擬延長至 70 ns（奈秒），找到兩個候選進出方向，並定位沿路的蛋白與脂質碰撞。這讓我們知道下一步應檢查哪些位置，但還沒找到經完整穿越驗證的通道。

text.en: We proposed 35 single-amino-acid substitutions and checked structures and docking poses for a subset of candidates. Docking tests how an odorant can fit into a receptor pocket. The design list is ready for further study, but no mutation yet has robust evidence of improved selectivity.
text.zh: 提出 35 個單點突變（各改變一個胺基酸），並完成部分候選的結構與 docking（分子在受體口袋中的放置姿態）檢查。已有可供後續研究的設計清單，但目前沒有穩健證據支持某個突變確實提升專一性。

note.en: The outcome is a traceable receptor-screening and prediction workflow, priority receptors and computational evidence to guide the next experiments. A more sensitive, more selective engineered receptor remains the next-stage validation goal.
note.zh: 我們建立了可追溯的受體篩選與預測流程，選出優先受體，並用計算實驗釐清值得繼續研究的特徵與候選路徑。「更敏感、更專一的工程受體」仍是下一階段要驗證的目標。
